title: RunCreate
description: Body for StartRun — first or subsequent invoke with graph input (NOT for HITL resume). Maps to LangGraph ainvoke(input, config) or Agent Server runs with input.

graph_id.description: Assistant id or graph name to execute

input.description: Graph input (e.g. messages). Do not use this field to continue after interrupt — use resume-request.json

durability.description: Checkpoint durability mode (Agent Server / LangGraph durable execution)

multitask_strategy.description: Behavior when another run is already active on the thread

webhook.description: Optional callback when run reaches terminal or interrupt wait

on_disconnect.description: Streaming disconnect policy; prefer continue for HITL-friendly UIs
